comparative_logic.Series_Circuit: Single loop. If one bulb blows, all stop. Adding bulbs makes them dimmer. Voltage adds up.
comparative_logic.Parallel_Circuit: Multiple branches. If one bulb blows, others stay lit. Bulbs stay bright. Batteries last longer.
comparative_logic.visual_reference: [IMAGE_019: Side-by-side comparison of Series and Parallel bulb circuits]

domestic_usage.Why_Parallel_at_Home: 1. Appliances can be used independently. 2. If one fails, the whole house doesn't go dark.
